verdict: Google profile engagement dropped sharply this week across all three locations.
narrative: Across Forte Metals, Advance Grinding, and O'Hare Precision, your Google Business Profile activity totalled 326 actions over the last 28 days — the only lead-generation channel active right now, as no paid media ran on Meta or Google Ads during this period. In the most recent 7 days, GBP engagement fell steeply at every location (between 84% and 97% week-over-week), with several consecutive zero-action days heading into this week; search clicks followed the same downward direction across all three. The web visibility root cause is identified and a fix is already in progress, with three sites targeted for reindexing by end of October. You should expect GBP and search numbers to remain soft in the near term before recovering as the site work takes effect.
